about: Measured soil temperature near 4 in for /fall-nitrogen. t is the last 10 daily values in F, oldest first, ending on 'last'; null means the station sent nothing that day. counties: fips -> [name, state, lat, lon] (center of the county) plus [station index, miles] when a station is within max_miles.

KSMESO.why: Kansas Mesonet data has no SOILTMP10AVG column (got ERROR: LIMIT OF 3000 RECORDS PER REQUEST)
